IAF Indian Air Force Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant Eligibility

Medical Assistant (For 10+2)

N/A
  • Passed 10+2 / Intermediate / Equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English. OR
  • Passed two years’ Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects i.e. Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English
  • Unmarried candidates born between 01 January 2006 to 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive).
  • More Eligibility Details Read the Notification.

Medical Assistant (For Diploma/ B.Sc in Pharmacy)

N/A
  • 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English (50% aggregate & 50% in English)
  • Diploma/ B.Sc in Pharmacy with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate.
  • Must have valid registration from State Pharmacy Council or Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)
  • Unmarried: Born between 01 January 2003 and 01 January 2008. AND Married: Born between 01 January 2003 and 01 January 2006. (Both dates inclusive)
  • More Eligibility Details Read the Notification.
